a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 first leaves us both with about a 4% survival chance. The reserve has exactly 4 now, so at most one of us can be safe after round 1. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and am telling you openly rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random and we likely both fail, so if you also want to take, say so and we can work out something fair. If no storm hits, I'll keep operating with you every round so you can reach 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
